evidence: Introduces an in-tree test runner and assertion framework in src/test/util/framework.{h,cpp} and src/test/main.cpp to replace Boost.Test.
rationale: Replaces Boost.Test with an in-tree assertion framework and runner, addressing longstanding tracking issues #34666 and #8670. Reviewer josibake notes this 'removes barriers to writing tests and enables concurrency improvements to speed up CI', while resolving failure diagnostic omissions and platform signal stack quirks.
